# Epsilon Publishing Group

> Turkish publishing group representing translation rights to children's books, fiction and non-fiction, with rights sold in almost 70 languages.

Epsilon Publishing Group (Istanbul, founded 1993) is one of Türkiye's leading publishing groups, with the imprints Epsilon, Kafka, Uçan Fil, Nemesis, Masalperest, Nora, Serenad, Okuyan Us and Okuyan Koala. Its rights team represents the group's authors and titles internationally: rights to more than 100 titles have been sold in almost 70 languages across 180 territories. This site lists every title available for translation, with its rights status, the rights catalogues and how to get in touch.

Rights enquiries: pelin@epsilonyayingrubu.com

## Start here

- [About the group](https://epsilonpublishinggroup.com/about-us/): history, imprints and the rights team

## Services

- [Copyrights](https://epsilonpublishinggroup.com/services/copyrights/): Territory-by-territory rights representation for authors and publishers, from first submission to signed contract.
- [Licensing](https://epsilonpublishinggroup.com/services/licensing/): Audio, film, television, serial, dramatic and merchandising rights, handled separately from print.
- [Translation](https://epsilonpublishinggroup.com/services/translation/): A vetted translator network and a sample-translation studio for titles going out to market.
- [Cultural Organisations](https://epsilonpublishinggroup.com/services/international-cultural-organisations/): Fellowship programmes, publisher delegations and fair representation for cultural institutions.
- [Publishing Grants](https://epsilonpublishinggroup.com/services/publishing-grants/): Grant identification, eligibility checks and application support for translation and publication funding.
